name: B10-0335/2025 (Verts/ALE) – Urgent need to protect religious minorities in Syria following the recent terrorist attack on Mar Elias Church in Damascus
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the urgent need to protect religious minorities in Syria following the recent terrorist attack on Mar Elias Church in Damascus
part_text:
The European Parliament strongly condemns recent violent attacks in Syria, including the June 2025 attack on a church in Damascus. It calls on Syria's interim authorities to investigate all violence fairly, hold those responsible to account, and protect every Syrian regardless of religion or ethnicity. It also says Syria is not yet safe for refugees to return to, and that any return must be truly voluntary, safe and dignified.

- The Parliament asks Syria's interim authorities to investigate attacks and protect all Syrians.
- It affects religious and ethnic minorities in Syria, and refugees considering return.
- Next, the Parliament sends its demands to the European Union's institutions and Syria's interim government.
